Problem Statement:
Given a number N which represents the number of people in a tournament, you need to adjust the number of participants to make it a power of 2 (which is required for a standard single-elimination tournament bracket structure). You can either give byes to some players (effectively removing them from the initial count), or add phantom players (who automatically lose, effectively increasing the count). Find the minimum number of adjustments needed to make the participant count equal to any power of 2. If N is already a power of 2, print '0'.
